Under the usual uniform lottery model, conditioning the winning ticket on this property leaves those four tickets equally likely, so Gamble's fixed eligible ticket wins with probability 1/4.

On pouring k, the fraction retained is 1 − 1/(k + 1) = k/(k + 1). After n pourings, the retained fraction is (1/2)(2/3)⋯(n/(n + 1)) = 1/(n + 1). Setting this equal to 1/10 gives n = 9. The complementary fractions, product cancellation, and indexing all agree with the proposed mapping.

Pythagorean right-triangle relations, or the distance formula, give 4u² + v² = 36 and u² + 4v² = 49. Hence AB² = u² + v² = (36 + 49)/5 = 17, so AB = √17.
